diagram_note: Educational stub from src/gunnchos_ran and the config stubs. The xApp policy maps a load field to slice eMBB or URLLC. This is not a measured Open RAN topology. This repository has no RU, DU, CU, near-RT RIC, non-RT RIC, rApp, E2, A1, or O1 relationship record.

rows.ethical_framing: KPI_FIELDS in src/gunnchos_ran/kpi_schema.py lists latency_ms, throughput_mbps, prb_util, packet_loss. results/oran_kpi_schema.yaml lists latency_ms and prb_util only.
policy() returns slice eMBB when load is below 0.7, otherwise URLLC. oran_step() only calls that policy.
CLASSES lists eMBB, URLLC, and mMTC.
srsRAN file is a stub: rf_driver zmq.
OAI file is a stub: mode sim.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: # gunnchOS Open RAN Testbed Lab > This repo is part of the **gunnchOS wireless engineering spine**: hands-on labs that strengthen the technical foundation behind 7GC, AI-RAN, RF, DSP, MIMO, measurement, and **6G PhD readiness** for target wireless communications engineering programs. Not affiliated with any university.

sections.title: What this is
sections.body: Research and teaching lab for **target wireless communications engineering programs**-aligned skills — built as an independent portfolio project.

sections.title: Why wireless engineering readiness cares
sections.body: O-RAN KPIs, xApp policy stubs, srsRAN/OAI config scaffolds — links spectrumx-ai-ran-gary.

sections.title: Commands
sections.body: make install && make test && make e2e

methods: Methods are the files under src/gunnchos_ran: kpi_schema.py, xapp_policy_stub.py, traffic_classes.py, and oran_loop.py, plus configs/srsran/stub.json and configs/oai/stub.json. The policy stub maps load to a slice label. No RU, DU, CU, RIC, rApp, E2, A1, or O1 relationship is recorded in this repository.
